No history, founding date, festival or festival-mela details are documented anywhere; all substantive details above (navratri worship, timings) are generic for Devi shrines and should be treated as unverified. Do NOT conflate with the famous Shakti shrine of the same name at Panchkula (Mani Majra, 1811-1815). name: Mata Mansa Devi Temple
town_description: Sonipat is an industrial and educational city in Haryana, about 44 km north of Delhi on the NH44 corridor. It is part of the National Capital Region and is an ancient town mentioned in the Mahabharata-era traditions of the region.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi, about 44-50 km from Sonipat.
travel.railway: Sonipat Junction is the nearest major railway station.
travel.road: The city is on NH44; local shrine address per map listings is within Sonipat city (exact address unverified).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather; Navratri is the usual peak season for Devi shrines (unverified for this shrine).
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not documented anywhere - verify locally before visiting.
